description: Widened the persistent n256 MathDx schedule from 32x32 to 64x64 tiles, reducing panel depth from eight to four and increasing device tensor-core update granularity without changing any dispatch or caller-stream/cache behavior. Build, policy gates, all official tests, six fresh n256 cases, and full benchmark passed. Target improved from 178.401 to 168.125 us; aggregate improved from 974.583 to 972.969 us.

Replaced benchmark batch64 n256 direct/grouped library calls with a caller-stream one-CTA-per-matrix MathDx left-looking factorization. Each persistent CTA performs 32x32 FP32 device Cholesky and triangular solves plus FP16-input/FP32-accumulate tile updates, writes a physical upper factor, and returns its transposed lower view from shape-scoped zeroed output storage. Build, banned-stream/kernelguard policy, all 17 tests, six fresh-seed n256 families, and every benchmark cell passed. Target fell from grouped 300.985 us to 178.401 us; full geomean reached 974.583 us versus 999.771 us parent.
Combining retained changes

Ran exact batch60 n1024 compact-FP16 panels through a caller-stream batch-aware CuTe persistent lower-triangular rank-k scheduler using 256x256 2-CTA MMA tiles and 2x1 clusters. Build, stream/kernelguard gates, all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guard, target correctness, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. Target measured 2152.331 us versus parent 2158.279 us; full aggregate measured 999.035 us.

Changed the batch-aware triangular CuTe schedule from 256x256 to 128x128 2-CTA MMA tiles with 2x1 clusters. Full validation and benchmark correctness passed. Target batch60 n1024 measured 2165.706 us versus 2152.331 us for 256x256; aggregate measured 1004.457 us, with unrelated large-shape run variance.

Replace warp-per-row n128 panel solves with 128 independent four-thread register row teams, retaining the 32-wide FP32 panel and compensated TF32 WMMA rank-k schedule. All mandatory static gates, official tests, and fresh guards passed. n128 improved from 170.152 to 65.501 us; the full metric improved from 1070.765 to 1008.151 us, remaining above the 998.975 parent.

Corrected the 2-CTA 256x128 persistent scheduler by expanding each triangular cluster coordinate into both 128-column subtiles. Build and all required correctness/policy checks passed. Large cells measured 4701.904/15316.978/61091.049 us and aggregate 1009.216 us, improving the 2-CTA 256x256 direct-TF32 trial at 1013.034 us but remaining above the 998.975 us explicit-FP16 parent.

Replaced benchmark batch64 n256 direct SpotrfBatched with a shape-scoped four-panel block-64 schedule using prewarmed output/pointer pools, batched FP32 panel potrf/TRSM, TF32 trailing GEMMs, and caller-stream triangle preparation. Build, kernelguard/banned-stream gates, all 17 official tests, six fresh-seed n256 cases, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. The target measured 300.985 us and full geomean 1010.383 us; all other dispatch remained unchanged.

Widened the grouped n256 schedule from four 64-wide panels to two 128-wide panels while preserving the prewarmed pointer/output pool and all non-n256 dispatch. Build, policy gates, all official tests, fresh-seed guard, and full-grid benchmark passed. The target measured 304.071 us versus 300.985 us at block64, and aggregate measured 1011.999 us.

Narrowed the persistent n256 MathDx schedule to 16x16 tiles and sixteen device-resident panels. All policy, official correctness, fresh-seed, and benchmark checks passed. Target measured 316.576 us versus 178.401/168.125 us at tile32/64 and aggregate measured 1012.582 us; the 16/32/64/128 structural sweep selected tile64.

Eliminated the standalone compact FP16 panel buffer and converter for batch-one n>=8192 by feeding solved strided FP32 panels directly into the SM100 CuTe TMA mainloop, which transforms loads to TF32 before tensor-core MMA. Build, official validation, kernelguard/banned-stream gates, fresh-seed guard, and full benchmark passed. Large cells measured 4709.626/15023.523/58016.797 us and aggregate 1013.034 us versus the 998.975 us parent.

Narrowed the grouped n256 panel schedule to eight block-32 stages to increase diagonal/panel batch concurrency while retaining prewarmed caller-stream storage. All build, policy, official validation, fresh-seed, and full benchmark checks passed. Target latency measured 309.143 us versus 300.985/304.071 us for block64/128; aggregate was 1014.755 us.

Replaced batched torch.linalg panel factorization with reusable compact column-major factor buffers, a persistent cuSOLVER workspace, and two serial caller-stream BF16x9 Spotrf calls per 2048 panel. Batched direct TRSM and per-matrix lower-only CuTe updates remained. All checks passed; batch-2 n=4096 improved from 7709.368 to 3852.275 us, batch-1 direct was 1431.853 us, and aggregate improved from 1069.313 to 1015.759 us.

Generalized the validated caller-stream direct-TRSM plus 2-CTA CuTe RankK stack to reusable 2048-wide factor and FP16 panel workspaces, and dispatched batch-1 n=4096 through two blocked panels. Build, kernelguard and banned-stream checks, all 17 official tests, fresh-seed guards, and all benchmark reconstructions passed. Target batch-1 n=4096 measured 1890.336 us; batch-2 remained direct at 2872.738 us; aggregate measured 1017.102 us versus 998.975 parent.

Changed the direct-FP32 CuTe rank-k from 2-CTA 256x256 clusters to one-CTA 128x128 persistent triangular tiles with 148 active clusters. All required checks passed. Large cells measured 4719.540/15597.386/66789.118 us and aggregate 1019.856 us, versus 1013.034 us for the 2-CTA TF32 transform and 998.975 us parent.

Narrowed the caller-stream batch-1 n=4096 blocked path from 2048 to 1024 panels, reusing the generalized factor and compact-FP16 workspaces and the same direct TRSM plus lower-only 2-CTA CuTe update. All required checks passed. Target measured 2147.126 us versus 1890.336 us at width 2048; batch-2 direct measured 2877.694 us; noisy full-grid aggregate was 1045.971 us.

Restricted grouped block-256 factorization to batch-8 n=2048 and restored serial direct cuSOLVER for batch-2 n=4096. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The grouped target measured 3086.247 us and restored n=4096 measured 2873.262 us, producing a new brief best aggregate of 1057.605 us versus parent 1086.905.

Changed grouped trailing GEMM compute from fast TF32 to fast BF16 conversion while retaining FP32 panels and the write-only triangle cleanup. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The target measured 3138.730 us and aggregate 1059.077 us, statistically close to the TF32 write-only variant at 3140.314/1060.157 and behind the library-cleanup leader.

Preserve caller-queue semantics across the integrated stack by adding PyTorch current-queue launch arguments to f041 live n=32/64/128 kernels; no new queue object or synchronization. Mandatory no-secondary-stream literal scan, kernelguard, 17 tests, and fresh guard passed. Cells 17.087/20.952/57.475 us and large 4671.879/14572.381/52676.890 us; aggregate 1060.062 us, within 0.11% of f041 1058.933.

Isolate scheduling transfer by restoring f041 original converter while retaining caller-current small launches and legal Cholesky -> direct TRSM -> conversion -> CuTe RankK -> tiled factor-copy order. Mandatory no-secondary-stream gate, kernelguard, 17 tests, and fresh guard passed. Large cells 4666.974/14547.365/52282.286 us; aggregate 1060.145 us, statistically tied with packed trial 52 1060.062 and f041 1058.933.

Restored block-256 strided TF32 trailing GEMMs and replaced the final full-tensor triu operation with a write-only kernel that clears only the physical lower half. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The target measured 3140.314 us and aggregate 1060.157 us, versus 3086.247/1057.605 with the library triu cleanup.

Restored the validated block-256 grouped TF32 configuration after data-movement and reduced-precision experiments. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The repeated target measured 3200.139 us and aggregate 1062.209 us; the identical earlier tree at ecec0c7 measured the brief best 3086.247/1057.605, with the difference within run-level variation.

Halved grouped n=2048 panels from 256 to 128 while preserving all other dispatch. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The target measured 3151.957 us and aggregate 1063.485 us, versus 3086.247/1057.605 at block 256.

Defer the caller-queue tiled factor copy until after CuTe RankK, still before the next reusable factor-workspace overwrite: Cholesky -> direct TRSM -> packed conversion -> RankK -> factor copy. Mandatory no-secondary-stream gate, kernelguard, 17 tests, and fresh guard passed. Large cells 4685.955/14627.590/52776.269 us; aggregate 1064.499 us, best integrated run but 0.53% above f041 1058.933.

Control: restore f041 original copy-before-TRSM caller-queue order and original converter while retaining explicit current-queue small launches. Mandatory no-secondary-stream gate, kernelguard, 17 tests, and fresh guard passed. Large cells 4678.563/14579.953/52398.126 us; aggregate 1064.781 us versus scheduling-only trial 53 1060.145 and combined trial 52 1060.062.

Place f041 tiled factor copy after packed panel conversion on the same caller queue: Cholesky -> direct TRSM -> conversion -> factor copy -> CuTe RankK. Mandatory no-secondary-stream gate, kernelguard, all official tests, and fresh guard passed. Large cells measured 4677.973/14572.762/52297.158 us; aggregate 1065.361 us, essentially tied with trial 49 1065.908 and still above f041 1058.933.

Restore byte-identical trial-52 combined integration for final certification: packed converter, caller-only direct-TRSM/factor-copy scheduling, f041 tiled factor copy/small kernels/CuTe dispatch, and explicit caller-current small launches. Final mandatory no-secondary-stream scan, kernelguard, 17 tests, fresh guard, and all benchmark cells passed. Final rerun 1065.440 us versus selected run 1060.062 us, within measured Modal noise.

On the packed-converter/f041 stack, reorder the legal caller-queue batch-one schedule to Cholesky -> direct cuBLAS TRSM -> tiled factor copy -> conversion -> CuTe RankK, with final-panel copy preserved. No auxiliary queue or events. Mandatory banned-secondary-stream gate, kernelguard, 17 tests, and fresh guard passed. Large cells were 4679.747/14597.421/52783.852 us; aggregate improved from trial 48 1077.830 to 1065.908 us.

Doubled grouped n=2048 panels from 256 to 512. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The target measured 3264.237 us and aggregate 1066.283 us, versus 3086.247/1057.605 at block 256; the measured 128/256/512 sweep is 3151.957/3086.247/3264.237 us.

Changed grouped trailing GEMM compute from fast BF16 to fast FP16 conversion while retaining FP32 panel factorization/solve. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The target measured 3263.099 us and aggregate 1069.126 us, slower than fast BF16 and TF32 variants.

Added a caller-stream persistent upper-clear kernel after the batch-2 2048-panel path, removing intra-diagonal-cluster CuTe upper writes. Build, all static policy gates, 17 official tests, fresh-seed guards, and every benchmark reconstruction passed. Batch-2 n=4096 measured 7709.368 us versus 2872.738 us direct; batch-1 direct measured 1435.312 us; aggregate was 1069.313 us.

Replace the recursive n128 factor with one persistent 512-thread CTA using FP32 32-wide diagonal panels and warp triangular solves, then compensated high/low TF32 WMMA lower rank-k updates. Caller-current launch, banned-text scan, kernelguard, all 17 official tests, and fresh-seed guard passed. n128 measured 170.152 us versus about 57 us for the parent; full geomean was 1070.765 us.

Replaced batch-wide full-square TF32 GEMMs with per-matrix lower-triangular TF32 SYRK updates and removed final triangle cleanup at block 256. Validation, guards, and benchmark correctness passed. The target measured 3759.068 us and aggregate 1074.489 us, versus 3086.247/1057.605 for strided full GEMM.

Transplant exact aef packed float4-to-uint2 FP32-to-FP16 converter onto global-best f041 while preserving its tiled lower-factor copy, custom small kernels, direct paths, and CuTe dispatch. Mandatory no-secondary-stream source gate, kernelguard, 17 official tests, and fresh-seed guard passed. Large cells measured 4689.186/14651.472/52715.712 us; full geomean 1077.830 us versus f041 1058.933 us.

Restored serial direct cuSOLVER at batch-2 n=4096 and replaced SpotrfBatched with eight serial workspace-backed Spotrf calls at batch-8 n=2048, testing the opposite legal concurrency crossover. Validation and guards passed. Batch-8 n=2048 measured 5073.175 us versus 4722.537 us for batched; aggregate was 1093.801 us versus parent 1086.905.

Widened the persistent n256 MathDx tile to 128x128, reducing the factorization to two device panels while consuming about 192 KiB of dynamic shared memory per CTA. Correctness, policy, official tests, fresh-seed guard, and all benchmark shapes passed, but the target regressed sharply to 1126.784 us versus 168.125 us at tile64; aggregate was 1102.745 us.

Added a caller-path grouped blocked Cholesky with persistent pointer tables, batch-wide FP32 diagonal potrf and TRSM, and strided TF32 trailing GEMMs at block 256 for batch-8 n=2048 and batch-2 n=4096. All official tests, fresh-seed guards, and benchmark correctness passed. Target cells measured 3188.609 and 5768.015 us respectively; n=2048 improved from 4722.537 while n=4096 regressed from 2875.762. Aggregate measured 1110.696 us.

Split batch-8 n=2048 into two sequential SpotrfBatched groups of four, preserving the original serial batch-2 n=4096 path. Validation and guards passed. The target cell measured 7177.293 us versus 4722.537 us for one batch of eight; aggregate measured 1116.651 us.

Reduced the policy-compliant batch-8 n=2048 internal concurrency group from four to two matrices per SpotrfBatched launch. Validation and guards passed. The target cell measured 16100.027 us and aggregate measured 1182.698 us, versus 7177.293/1116.651 for groups of four and 4722.537 for all eight.

Replaced the serial two-call n=4096 batch-2 path with cuSOLVER SpotrfBatched so cuSOLVER controls matrix-level concurrency without forbidden secondary streams. Validation passed all 17 official tests and the fresh-seed variation guard. Batch-2 n=4096 measured 11103.192 us and aggregate regressed from parent 1086.905 to 1188.092 us.

Completed the n=2048 batch-group sweep by issuing eight SpotrfBatched calls of one matrix each. Validation and fresh-seed guards passed. The target cell measured 28303.285 us and aggregate 1228.181 us, confirming the measured monotonic benefit of larger legal batch concurrency: 1=28303.285, 2=16100.027, 4=7177.293, 8=4722.537 us.

Completed the n=4096 legal batched-API grouping sweep by replacing the serial workspace-backed pair with two SpotrfBatched calls of one matrix. Validation and guards passed. Batch-2 n=4096 measured 20557.510 us and aggregate 1247.836 us, versus 11103.192 us for one batch of two and 2875.762 us for serial workspace-backed Spotrf.

Enabled the native cuBLASDx pipeline descriptor while retaining the shared-memory execute API; validation and guards passed. B640 N512 was statistically identical at 1912.249 us versus 1912.231 us, so the aggregate 1289.183446 us difference is unrelated variance and the inert knob was rejected.

Restored the uncapped persistent N=512 MathDx kernel after rejecting 64- and 96-register caps. Fresh full validation passed all 17 official cases and all fresh-seed guards; benchmark reconfirmed 1911.045 us on batch=640,n=512 and 1289.916204 us aggregate. This is the retained clean head.

At the winning 4096-CTA persistent grid, packed the two converted half2 values into one aligned uint2 store. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Aggregate measured 1290.116 us, but the directly affected n32768 case regressed from the two-store 59745.441 to 60150.710 us; batch60 n1024 was 2279.906 us and n8192/16384 were 4896.501/15831.328 us. The aggregate gain was driven by unrelated-shape noise, so the two-half2 form remains the large-panel choice.

Fused each diagonal writeback with the first trailing-panel load/update, retaining required barriers while removing one transfer loop and duplicate index setup; validation and guards passed. B640 N512 improved to 1912.231 us and aggregate reached 1290.832648 us.
Restored byte-identical validated first-panel-only fusion after the chained-fusion live-range regression; retained measured B640 N512 1912.231 us and aggregate 1290.832648 us.
Restored byte-identical validated 12-KiB MathDx shared layout after cached L[0,k] reduced residency; retained measured B640 N512 1912.231 us and aggregate 1290.832648 us.
Restored byte-identical validated effective MathDx descriptor after the pipeline-only flag proved inert on shared-memory execute; retained measured B640 N512 1912.231 us and aggregate 1290.832648 us.
Restored byte-identical validated dynamic cuBLASDx block handling after static specialization regressed the target; retained measured B640 N512 1912.231 us and aggregate 1290.832648 us.
Restored byte-identical validated separate MathDx solver status after the b_shared overlay regressed the target; retained measured B640 N512 1912.231 us and aggregate 1290.832648 us.

Changed the conversion-only float4 panel kernel from one-shot CTAs to a grid-stride persistent launch capped at 4096 CTAs, preserving coalesced accesses while amortizing scheduling for up to roughly 115k original blocks. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Geomean improved from 1294.994 to 1291.029 us; n32768 improved from 60214.624 to 59745.441 us, with n8192/16384 at 4898.003/15823.904 us and batch60 n1024 at 2286.445 us.

Replace looped classic Spotrf for batch<=4,n>=1024 with generic Xpotrf ALG_0 while retaining BF16x9 math mode; cache the params object and shape-scoped device/host byte workspaces. Validation and fresh-seed guards passed. Full-grid geomean measured 1291.615 us; looped cells measured 1224.754 us at batch=4,n=1024, 1252.086 us at batch=2,n=2048, and 1429.894/2870.094 us at n=4096.

Restored two half2 stores at the winning 4096-CTA persistent conversion grid and ran a fresh final comparator. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Every directly affected mixed shape beat the packed uint2 variant: batch60 n1024 2277.598 vs 2279.906 us, and n8192/16384/32768 4885.926/15779.392/59935.167 vs 4896.501/15831.328/60150.710 us. Final robust geomean measured 1291.665 us; prior same-code run measured 1291.029 us.

Restore potrfBatched at batch=8,n=2048 and request CUSOLVER_ALLOW_NON_DETERMINISTIC_RESULTS for both direct execution and Xpotrf workspace queries. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1292.007 us versus 1291.615 us in deterministic-default mode, with direct cells within run noise.

Select CUSOLVER_ALG_2 for persistent Xpotrf. Validation and fresh-seed guards passed with the same residual profile as ALG_0. Full geomean measured 1292.037 us, essentially matching ALG_0/non-deterministic samples; looped cells were 1226.621, 1253.745, and 1431.382/2871.323 us.

Fix the inverse hybrid by looping Xpotrf over every matrix: use classic Spotrf for batch=1 and Xpotrf for batch=2/4 with separate persistent workspaces. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1293.625 us versus 1291.615 us with Xpotrf throughout; classic batch=1,n=4096 measured 1434.413 us while Xpotrf batch=2 cells measured 1255.643/2876.629 us.

Restore BF16x9 and allocate both persistent generic and classic workspaces, using Xpotrf for batch=1 but looped classic Spotrf for batch=2/4. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1293.718 us versus 1291.615 us with Xpotrf throughout; classic cells measured 1231.350 us at batch=4,n=1024, 1256.560 us at batch=2,n=2048, and 2874.425 us at batch=2,n=4096.

Reduced the persistent conversion-only float4 grid from 4096 to 1184 CTAs, corresponding to eight 256-thread CTAs per B200 SM. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. The narrower grid regressed n32768 from 59745.441 to 59917.109 us and geomean from 1291.029 to 1294.116 us; batch60 n1024 measured 2281.991 us.

Consolidated fused factor/pointer preparation, direct TRSM, packed FP16 conversion, and FP16-input rank-k update into one C++ extension call per non-final panel, preserving identical GPU work/order while removing three Python/dispatcher crossings per panel. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Geomean improved to a new best 1294.994 us; batch60 n1024 measured 2276.223 us; n8192/16384/32768 measured 4889.984/15819.307/60214.624 us.

Added a conversion-only float4 kernel for direct-TRSM panels so the FP16 operand is emitted without redundantly rewriting the same FP32 panel; separate-source paths retain fused store+convert. All checks passed. Batch-60,n=1024 measured 2332.672 us versus 2334.365 us with the redundant store; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 5001.824/16089.738/60936.704 us versus 5005.523/16134.293/61196.246 us, and full geomean reached 1295.665 us versus 1296.530 us.

Restored explicit packed FP16 staging and refined fused factor-copy/pointer preparation to skip upper tiles and store only the logical lower factor, which is sufficient because TRSM reads the separate factor and output.tril_ discards the upper half. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Batch60 n1024 improved from 2284.715 to 2272.669 us; n8192/16384/32768 improved to 4909.018/15869.344/60238.806 us; geomean measured 1296.122 us.

Fused the column-major factor transpose/copy with batched factor/panel pointer preparation in one tiled CUDA launch, removed the separate pointer-fill launch, and carried the measured n=1024 width256 crossover. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Batch60 n1024 improved from width256 control 2324.256 us to 2284.715 us; n8192/16384/32768 improved to 4921.222/15936.864/60556.203 us. Full geomean measured 1296.384 us amid unrelated-shape noise.

Adapted the direct cuBLAS TRSM binding to torch's column-major Cholesky factor layout while retaining row-major support, solving mixed panels in their final output storage and using device-built pointer arrays for batch 60. Build, official validation, fresh guards, and all benchmarks passed. Batch-60,n=1024 fell to 2334.365 us from 2420.146 us for allocating torch solve plus fused conversion; n=8192/16384/32768 fell to 5005.523/16134.293/61196.246 us from 5058.323/16369.696/62009.973 us, and full geomean reached 1296.530 us versus 1303.703 us.

Consolidate the measured all-Xpotrf low-batch schedule by removing the dual classic-workspace machinery while preserving ALG_0, BF16x9, and persistent device/host workspaces. Validation and guards passed. This semantically matches trial 0; a fresh full-grid sample measured 1296.993 us versus trial 0 at 1291.615 us, with the largest sampling shift at batch=8,n=2048 (4919.696 versus 4719.259 us).

Direct cuBLAS TRSM with conversion-only alias kernel and shape-specific n=1024 panel width 192. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Geomean measured 1297.080 us; batch60 n1024 measured 2362.543 us, both behind width 128 (1295.665/2332.672 us). Large batch1 shapes measured 5010.035/16059.424/60294.912 us.

Restore potrfBatched at n=512 and move the looped-Xpotrf cutoff from n>=1024 to n>=2048, measuring potrfBatched for both the low- and high-batch n=1024 cases. Validation and guards passed. Batch=4,n=1024 rose from about 1224 us on Xpotrf to 1265.622 us on potrfBatched; full geomean measured 1297.326 us.

Restore looped Xpotrf for every batch<=4,n>=1024 direct shape and replace BF16x9 emulated FP32 with CUSOLVER_DEFAULT_MATH for workspace query and execution. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1297.935 us versus 1291.615 us with BF16x9; high-batch direct cells included 587.062 us at n=512 and 4955.134 us at n=2048.

Direct cuBLAS TRSM with conversion-only alias kernel and shape-specific n=1024 panel width 256. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Batch60 n1024 improved to 2324.256 us versus width128 2332.672 us, while batch4 n1024 measured 1229.775 us and noisy full geomean was 1298.399 us. Large batch1 shapes measured 4998.950/16121.878/61281.333 us.

Extend persistent looped Xpotrf from batch<=4 to batch=8 at n=2048. Validation and guards passed. The batch=8,n=2048 cell rose from 4719.259 us with potrfBatched to 5074.638 us with eight Xpotrf calls; full geomean rose from 1291.615 to 1298.516 us.

Repeated the direct-TRSM width-128 control after the n=1024 sweep. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Batch60 n1024 repeated at 2334.402 us and batch4 n1024 at 1228.846 us; full geomean was 1298.584 us. Contemporaneous width256 was faster on batch60 (2324.256 us) and full geomean (1298.399 us), with a 0.929 us batch4 tradeoff.

Direct cuBLAS TRSM with conversion-only alias kernel and shape-specific n=1024 panel width 96. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Geomean measured 1299.522 us; batch60 n1024 measured 2415.505 us, substantially behind width 128 (1295.665/2332.672 us). Large batch1 shapes measured 5003.696/16050.901/60334.485 us.

Reduced the 32x32 persistent CTA to 64 threads; validation and guards passed. B640 N512 regressed significantly to 2009.157 us from 1967.208 us despite unrelated-shape variance lowering aggregate to 1300.639721 us, so rejected on isolated target performance.

Direct cuBLAS TRSM with conversion-only alias kernel and shape-specific n=1024 panel width 160. Official validation and fresh-input guard passed; full benchmark passed. Geomean regressed from width-128 1295.665 us to 1301.374 us; batch60 n1024 regressed from 2332.672 us to 2354.678 us. Large batch1 shapes measured 5002.464/16087.830/60772.406 us.

Reduced the 32x32 persistent MathDx CTA from 256 to 128 threads to raise residency and lower register pressure; official validation and guards passed. B640 N512 improved 23% to 1967.208 us and aggregate reached a new best of 1301.848119 us.
Restored byte-identical validated 32x32/128-thread MathDx content after the 64-thread target regression; retained measured B640 N512 1967.208 us and aggregate 1301.848119 us.
Restored byte-identical validated 32x32/128-thread MathDx content after the 16x16 fragmentation regression; retained measured B640 N512 1967.208 us and aggregate 1301.848119 us.

Restored the sweep-leading width 128 and widened the fused solved-panel pass to aligned float4 loads/stores producing two packed half2 values per index, retaining half2/scalar fallbacks. Build, all official validation cases, fresh-input guards, and all 15 benchmark reconstructions passed. Batch-60,n=1024 fell to 2420.146 us from 2443.951 us with float2/half2 and 2468.414 us before fusion; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 5058.323/16369.696/62009.973 us, and full geomean reached 1303.703 us versus the 1306.110 us parent.

Chained every panel store with preload of the next panel/update operands as a supported double-buffer analogue; validation and guards passed, but increased live ranges regressed B640 N512 to 2242.782 us and aggregate to 1305.468904 us.

Specialized cuBLASDx to a static 128-thread block dimension; validation and guards passed, but B640 N512 regressed to 1983.889 us and aggregate to 1305.677517 us, so dynamic block handling is faster in the mixed solver/GEMM kernel.

Replaced direct float4 solved-panel loads with explicit 16-byte cp.async staging into shared memory before the fused FP32 store and packed-FP16 conversion. Build, all official validations, fresh-input guards, and all benchmarks passed. Batch-60,n=1024 measured 2424.817 us versus 2420.146 us for direct float4 loads; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 5043.213/16390.517/62169.034 us, and full geomean measured 1305.739 us versus 1303.703 us for the direct-load winner.

Capped the persistent N=512 MathDx kernel at 64 registers per thread. All 17 official validations and the fresh-seed input-variation guard passed, but target latency regressed from 1912.231 to 1978.280 us and aggregate from 1290.832648 to 1306.800656 us, indicating spill cost outweighed occupancy benefit.

Restored the sweep-leading 128-wide n=1024 panels and added one shape-scoped persistent FP16 panel buffer, converting each solved panel into reusable storage rather than allocating a fresh half tensor per update. Build, validation, guards, and all benchmark checks passed. The n=1024 batch-60 cell measured 2495.840 us versus 2468.414 us for the allocation-per-update width-128 trial; full geomean measured 1307.965 us versus 1310.535 us, with the unchanged n=2048 batch-8 cell sampling 3.2% faster.

Restored the separate solved-panel tensor and added one CUDA pass that reads it once, stores the final FP32 panel, and emits the reusable FP16 update operand, replacing two generic copy/conversion passes. Build and all correctness checks passed. The n=1024 batch-60 cell measured 2506.988 us versus 2495.840 us for separate generic copies, large mixed cells measured 5101.318/16642.997/63382.645 us, and full geomean measured 1308.163 us versus 1307.965 us.

Vectorized the fused solved-panel store/conversion with aligned float2 loads/stores and half2 conversion, retaining the scalar fallback for arbitrary layouts. All checks passed. The n=1024 batch-60 cell fell from 2506.988 us on the scalar fused kernel to 2443.951 us, while n=8192/16384/32768 measured 5063.923/16432.864/62415.146 us; full geomean measured 1308.376 us versus 1308.163 us in a sample with slower unchanged n=512 cells.
